item.title: Amnesty International calls for abolition of ICE in report documenting rights violations
item.description: Amnesty International called for the abolition of US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), which is tasked with leading Donald Trump’s anti-immigrant crackdown, in a report released on Thursday. The report, titled “We Had Whistles, They Had Guns”, documents widespread human rights violations during ICE’s large-scale operations, the rights watchdog said. The release comes less than a week after a Venezuelan migrant, Wilber Garces Perez, was shot and wounded by an ICE agent in Austin, Texas,... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Michael Tilson Thomas’ 32-year home is now on sale for $9.85M
item.description: Michael Tilson Thomas’s residence in Pacific Heights is now on the market following his passing earlier this year. The mansion was a sanctuary for the musician and his husband Joshua Robison for nearly three decades. Built in 1906, the four-level home features a blend of architectural styles and modern amenities added over the years. Its spacious rooms hosted numerous distinguished guests from the music and architecture worlds. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Thailand’s solar scheme faces hurdles as low power users turned off by high cost
item.description: Toey Wattana Mongkhonnam began thinking about outfitting his family home in Thailand’s northeastern province of Yasothon with solar panels during the Covid-19 pandemic. In his household of five, electricity use rises with the day’s heat, and the monthly bill could range from 1,000 baht to 1,500 baht (US$30 to US$45). “Back then, I checked prices and a rooftop panel system that could put out enough power to run my household’s appliances could cost 100,000 baht to 200,000 baht,” said Toey, a Muay... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
